name: @pipeworx/mcp-tomorrow-io

tools.name: realtime
tools.description: Get current/real-time weather conditions for a location — temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind, precipitation probability, cloud cover, UV index, and visibility. Location can be "lat,lon" coordinates or a city name. Example: realtime({ location: "new york", units: "imperial" }) or realtime({ location: "40.71,-74.01" })

location.description: Location to look up — either "lat,lon" coordinates (e.g. "40.71,-74.01") or a city name (e.g. "new york", "london")

_apiKey.description: Tomorrow.io API key (optional — get a free one at tomorrow.io; if omitted the platform key is used)

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Get a daily or hourly weather forecast for a location. Returns a list of forecast periods with conditions, temperatures, precipitation probability, and wind. Location can be "lat,lon" coordinates or a city name. Example: forecast({ location: "london", timestep: "1d", units: "metric" })

location.description: Location to look up — either "lat,lon" coordinates (e.g. "40.71,-74.01") or a city name (e.g. "new york")

_apiKey.description: Tomorrow.io API key (optional — get a free one at tomorrow.io; if omitted the platform key is used)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tomorrow-io forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tomorrow-io pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
